text: MCP: suggest_repo_links — match a graph's open ideas against other local graphs' portable mission line (meta), never their ideas
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: to wire 9 ~/dev graphs into Felix's life graph, the agent matched life ideas to repos with a keyword script over every graph's idea texts. That reads the other graphs' internals, which e81b11c3 rules out for links.

Felix 2026-11-23 shaped it: "support subtitles, and deliver top 3 intrinsically valuable ideas." Each graph describes itself to others by (1) an optional subtitle in meta.json (one line, editable) and (2) its up to 3 ideas with the highest intrinsic value: what the graph says matters most to it, not its internals. suggest_repo_links(graph) matches the calling graph's open ideas against these self-descriptions of the other local graphs (embeddings) and returns ranked (idea, repo, similarity, the matched line) candidates. It only suggests; link_repo does the linking. The subtitle is a new optional meta field, so it goes through a data model migration.

Refuted if the suggestions are mostly wrong for Felix's life graph.

status.comment: Built as Felix shaped it: data model 9 adds meta.subtitle (one line, project settings field under the name; no-op migration, frozen data-model-v8 fixture, protocol schemas + README); backend spaces/link-suggestions.ts reads another space only through its self-description (subtitle + up to 3 ideas of highest intrinsic value; none without a repoId or without anything to say) and ranks (open idea, space) pairs by embedding similarity, best line per space, max 3 spaces per idea; project.suggestSpaceLinks (local-only) leaves out this space and those it links; MCP suggest_space_links (local-only). Evidence: link-suggestions.test (self-description reads only subtitle + top 3, ranking/threshold/per-idea cap), tools-with-accounts (local-only), migration tests incl. data-model-v8, verify:migration on v7 and ~/life clean, pnpm check 25/25. EXPERIMENT on this machine for v7 (no space has a subtitle yet, so only top-valued ideas): 6 spaces read; the top pair was right (Plant Aimparency at Commons Hub → an-der-rax, 'commons hub', 0.72), most others were lexical noise (e.g. 'Connect the loop to the outside world' → holophonor 'Web loop station', 0.707) at overlapping scores, so the default threshold went from 0.5 to 0.65. Not yet tested on the life space (the refutation criterion), and suggestions should improve once spaces carry subtitles written to describe what they are for. Hypothesis so far: mechanism works, precision without subtitles is low.
